querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      s_est_institute,
                                      s_est_ratinganalyst,
                                      s_est_estnewtime_inst,
                                      s_est_scorerating_inst,
                                      s_est_prescorerating_inst,
                                      s_est_lowprice_inst,
                                      s_est_highprice_inst,
                                      s_est_prelowprice_inst,
                                      s_est_prehighprice_inst,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      s_est_rating_inst,
                                      s_est_prerating_inst,
                                      s_est_report_title,
                                      s_est_report_type,
                                      s_est_ratinganalystid,
                                      s_rating_change,
                                      s_rating_validenddt,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_asharestockrating.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.asharestockrating WHERE s_est_estnewtime_inst BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
